title: Edit a card document
summary: Save a revision of the document bound to a card slot.
purpose: Save a revision of the document bound to a card slot.
request: Read the latest body and identifiers with {{route:chat.slot_document}}, then POST `expected_doc_id`, `expected_revision`, the complete `content`, and `idempotency_key` to {{route:chat.slot_document.revise}}.
response: A new revision is stored on the same document.
errors: If the document or revision changed, reread the slot and apply the edits to the latest content. Report read-mode refusals.
